title: Double-booking race condition
impact: Two concurrent bookings for the same slot both succeed
recommendation: Add a partial unique index or re-check inside the transaction

title: N+1 query on professional list
impact: List endpoint fires 1 query per professional when loading relations
recommendation: Use find({ relations: { reviews: true } }) with a single join

title: JWT secret hardcoded in docker-compose
impact: JWT signing secret is visible in the repo, tokens can be forged
recommendation: Move to an environment variable, rotate the secret

title: Missing input validation on phone field
impact: Malformed phone numbers are accepted and stored
recommendation: Add @Matches with a phone regex or use class-validator phone pipe

title: Dashboard bundle is 2.4MB uncompressed
impact: First load takes 3+ seconds on mobile networks
recommendation: Enable code splitting, lazy-load admin routes, tree-shake lodash

title: Inconsistent error response shape
impact: Some endpoints return { error, message }, others return { statusCode, message }
recommendation: Standardize on the NestJS HttpException filter shape everywhere
